title: Oxygen percent vs oxygen pressure
note: Approved narration (tools/videos/DESIGN.md). Drafted with AI assistance (Claude Code); approved by AlanziM2. Editing a recorded script costs ElevenLabs credits.

sentences.say: Two numbers describe the oxygen in a cabin, and they mean very different things.
sentences.show: Two numbers describe the oxygen in a cabin, and they mean very different things.

sentences.say: The first is oxygen percent: what share of the gas molecules are oxygen. It controls how easily things burn.
sentences.show: The first is oxygen percent: what share of the gas molecules are oxygen. It controls how easily things burn.

sentences.say: The second is oxygen partial pressure: how hard the oxygen alone pushes. It controls whether you can breathe.
sentences.show: The second is oxygen partial pressure: how hard the oxygen alone pushes. It controls whether you can breathe.

sentences.say: To find it, multiply the oxygen share by the total pressure.
sentences.show: To find it, multiply the oxygen share by the total pressure.

sentences.say: At sea level, that is about twenty one percent of 14.7 pounds per square inch, or 3.07.
sentences.show: At sea level, that is about twenty one percent of 14.7 psi, or 3.07.

sentences.say: Astronauts heading out on spacewalks are helped by a lower cabin pressure.
sentences.show: Astronauts heading out on spacewalks are helped by a lower cabin pressure.

sentences.say: But lower the pressure, and you must raise the oxygen percent to keep breathing the same.
sentences.show: But lower the pressure, and you must raise the oxygen percent to keep breathing the same.

sentences.say: A planned Moon Base at 10.2 pounds per square inch needs about thirty percent oxygen.
sentences.show: A planned Moon Base at 10.2 psi needs about thirty percent oxygen.

sentences.say: Its crew would breathe just as they do on Earth, but the air around them would be far more flammable.
sentences.show: Its crew would breathe just as they do on Earth, but the air around them would be far more flammable.

sentences.say: That trade, easier spacewalks against greater fire risk, is exactly what Flashpoint maps.
sentences.show: That trade, easier spacewalks against greater fire risk, is exactly what Flashpoint maps.
